# LIA-2026-001: AI lead scoring from LinkedIn data

| Kind | Status | Version | RoPA entry | Purposes | Regimes | Business owner | Next review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Legitimate interests assessment | Draft | 0.1 | ROPA-0001 | P1 | EU GDPR, UK GDPR | Head of Marketing | 2027-10-18 |

**Decision:** Open. Provisional: Balancing depends on how the data is obtained (Q1) and the notice (A1)

**Method:** GDPR and UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(f): purpose, necessity, and balancing tests (CJEU C-621/22; EDPB Guidelines 1/2024; ICO legitimate interests guidance)

This assessment proposes a decision. It authorizes no processing; only the privacy lead's recorded approval does.

Marketing scores B2B prospects from LinkedIn profile data so Sales can prioritize outreach. The company relies on its interest in finding likely buyers.

**Tests:** Purpose Yes · Necessity TBC · Balancing Open

**Open items:** 0 questions block launch · 2 block approval
**Launch:** blocked by A1 (law).

## Analysis

Prioritizing B2B outreach is a legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f), Recital 47), but necessity and balancing turn on facts not yet known: the data source, the notice, and whether AI scoring beats simpler ranking. Provisionally open; it leans toward holding if the source is licensed, the inputs are limited, and an Art. 14 notice is given.

## 1. Purpose test (Art. 6(1)(f))

| Interest | Whose | What the processing achieves | Legitimate | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prioritize sales outreach to prospects most likely to buy | Company | Sales contacts fewer, better-matched prospects | Yes. Provisional: A commercial interest that is lawful and clearly stated | Stated by: Marketing request |

## 2. Necessity test (Art. 6(1)(f))

Scoring needs job title, company, and seniority to rank prospects

| Less intrusive option | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Manual review of inbound leads only | Rejected: misses outbound prospects Sales targets |
| Firmographic scoring without personal data | Possible for account-level ranking; asked in Q2 |

**Minimization:** No profile photos, contact networks, or posts

**Necessary:** TBC: Depends on whether account-level scoring would do (Q2)

## 3. Balancing test (Art. 6(1)(f); Recital 47)

| People | Relationship | Reasonable expectations | Vulnerable |
|---|---|---|---|
| B2B prospects with public LinkedIn profiles | None; prospects haven't contacted us | TBC: Depends on how the data is obtained and what LinkedIn tells members (Q1) | No. Provisional: Adults in a professional context |

| Impact on the people | Likelihood | Severity | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unexpected sales contact from a company they never dealt with | High | Low | Every scored prospect may be contacted; contact is a single email |
| Profiling they can't see or correct | Medium | Medium | Scores only order the sales queue; accuracy of job titles is unknown |

**Outcome:** Open. Provisional: Expectations and notice not yet settled
